title: Patient Cost-Sharing Charges on the Insured Plan of Care
content:
**Patient financial responsibility terms — Insured Plan of Care.** These terms state which cost-sharing charges are posted to the patient's balance on a plan of care and when.

## Terms in force

1. Patient responsibility is posted only while the plan is not closed — that is, while it is in intake, active, on hold or discharged status.
2. Where the payer program does not allow cost sharing to be billed, nothing is ever posted to the patient for a covered visit.
3. Where the payer program collects the copay at the time of service, the copay on file is posted as a copay charge on each billed visit, but no more than the payer program's maximum number of copays are posted for one date of service across all of the patient's plans with the same payer, and a copay of $0.00 on file posts nothing.
4. A non-covered service charge is posted only under the calendar-year visit limit terms of the Insured Plan of Care, for a visit beyond the limit.
5. A charge returned from a payment plan re-posts the unpaid part of a charge that came back from a defaulted or cancelled Patient Payment Plan and carries the original charge's reference.

## Retired terms

- Where the payer program collects a deductible estimate at the time of service and deductible remains on file, the earlier clause read: "a deductible estimate charge of the lower of the visit's allowed amount, the deductible remaining and the payer program's time-of-service deductible estimate cap is posted." This clause is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis for the deductible part collected when a patient pays ahead of a visit.
- Where the payer program bills coinsurance after the explanation of benefits, the earlier clause read: "the coinsurance and any deductible shown on the payer's explanation of benefits are posted as coinsurance or deductible charges within the payer program's posting period, in calendar days, after the explanation of benefits arrives," less any deductible estimate already posted for that visit. This clause is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis for the coinsurance share collected when a patient pays ahead of a visit.

**Status evidence.** Whether the plan is closed is read from the plan's status in the system record.

## Copay posting — hypothetical cases

| Situation (hypothetical) | Copay posted |
|---|---|
| Copay on file $30.00, program collects the copay at the time of service, one visit on the date | One $30.00 copay charge |
| Same patient treated that day under two plans with the same payer, program maximum 1 copay per date of service | One copay for the date, not two |
| Copay on file $0.00 | Nothing |
| Program does not allow cost sharing to be billed | Nothing for a covered visit |
| Plan is closed | Nothing is posted |
